episodes.title: 7:00 PM
episodes.summary: Clare picks up her passenger, Carl E. A nice young man. Who lives in a mansion. On his way to the airport. Or so it seems.

episodes.title: 8:00 PM
episodes.summary: Clare leaves Carl E behind after a crash. But the cops make a discovery that has her questioning her sanity.

episodes.title: 9:00 PM
episodes.summary: Clare heads home to her apartment, but a complaint call to her work leads her to believe she may not be home alone.

episodes.title: 10:00 PM
episodes.summary: She can run. But she can't hide. Clare does her best to escape and find sanctuary in a nearby church.

episodes.title: 11:00 PM
episodes.summary: Clare returns to the gas station to seek help from a previous acquaintance. Turns out, she may not be the only victim.

episodes.title: 12:00 AM
episodes.summary: Clare forms an unlikely friendship. But a run-in with the law creates more chaos in the search for safety.

episodes.title: 1:00 AM
episodes.summary: They're on the run and wanted for murder. Clare and her friend plan to escape across the border. But Carl E is hot on their heels.

episodes.title: 2:00 AM
episodes.summary: Clare and her companion move through the underbelly of Los Angeles with new dangers lurking around every corner.

episodes.title: 3:00 AM
episodes.summary: After everything they've been through, Clare and JJ introduce themselves. But sometimes, people aren't who they claim to be.

episodes.title: 4:00 AM
episodes.summary: Done running. Done hiding. Clare confesses her story to the cops. Can she come up with a plan to save herself?

episodes.title: 5:00 AM
episodes.summary: The chase is over. The cops are on their way. But Carl E isn't done with his game just yet.

episodes.title: 6:00 AM
episodes.summary: Defeated. Desperate. Nowhere to turn. Clare feels too tired to continue. Until Carl E gives her a new reason to keep fighting.

episodes.title: 7:00 AM
episodes.summary: It's time to end this. Clare sets out into the city to finally confront Carl.
